title: Update HarfBuzz to 13.1.1 and optionally use new `hb-raster` API to render glyphs.
body: Updates HarfBuzz to the current upstream version - https://github.com/harfbuzz/harfbuzz/releases/tag/13.1.1 Before: After: Palette of the COLR fonts can be selected/customized via `FontVariation`: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3bf062a6-5da6-4007-8a04-b5905eba5bf3 Note: New HarfBuzz release seems to include a bunch of AI assisted code, but since it was committed by the library creator I assume it was properly verified and should not be a concern.
